units.source_text: 约莫过了半小时，没想到叶子他们也和岛村在同一个车站下了车，

en.t: About half an hour later, unexpectedly, Yoko and the others also got off at the same station as Shimamura,

units.source_text: 这使他觉得好像还会发生什么同自己有关的事似的，所以他把头转了过去。

en.t: This made him feel as though something else connected with him might happen, so he turned his head back.

units.source_text: 从站台上迎面扑来一阵寒气，他立即对自己在火车上那种非礼行为感到羞愧，

en.t: A blast of cold air came at him from the platform, and he immediately felt ashamed of his rude behavior on the train,

units.source_text: 就头也不回地从火车头前面走了过去。

en.t: then walked past the front of the locomotive without looking back.
